text:
Maria: Heads up — AcmeCorp RFP asked for SOC 2 report, ISO excerpt, and a signed pen-test letter. They want everything in the dataroom by Mon EOD. Can we hit that?
Jordan: We can drop the SOC 2 attestation PDF and the control-matrix export today. ISO excerpt is a redacted copy we keep on file. Pen-test letter = depends on vendor signatory. I have the template.
Alex: Quick pricing note — if they insist on dedicated tenancy for the POC that triggers reserved pricing. Can we propose hosted POC with strict IP allowlist to avoid dedicated cost?
Maria: They pushed back on hosted for data residency reasons. Asked if a private deployment trial is possible for the week.
Sam: From security: we'll need to confirm KMS separation and whether they require HSM-backed keys. Also need a redacted network diagram for their infra review. I can produce the diagram redacting customer endpoints.
Maria: Perfect. Jordan can you export the control matrix and point to the exact SOC 2 sections? The buyer's security lead will reference controls.
Jordan: Yep — exporting now. Control IDs and sample evidence paths will be included. I'll attach sample logs and the test run summary.
Sam: For pen-test letter — we need contact name at their side for the vendor to sign. Also flag: external scan window must be coordinated with oncall. Who is doing oncall next week?
Alex: Ops calendar shows @mike-oncall Tue/Wed. We can offer Wed 0200-0600 UTC for external scan.
Maria: I'll ask AcmeCorp for the signer and accept the Wed window. Also asking legal to review the pen-test letter template.
sec-bot: compliance-bot uploaded compliance-pack-v2.zip to the shared dataroom (presigned URL expires in 7 days). :package:
Jordan: Adding a tiny how-to for presigned upload for their scans: 
```
# generate presigned
POST /dataroom/presign
{ "path": "acmecorp/scan-results/2026-03-10" }
```
Maria: Great — I'll send a single email with: dataroom link, requested signer info, proposed scan window, and confirmation that SOC 2 + ISO excerpts are attached.
Alex: One last thing — if they insist on encrypted backups with customer-managed keys, that bumps the engagement to Private tier. Call that out in the email as an optional add-on.
Maria: Noted. Sending in 10. :email:
